lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁游，光一照进来我就退。
lines.en: I swim along the cave wall and retreat from any light.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像四条腿，划得很慢。
lines.en: My fins work like four legs, slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 这条暗渠我游了几百万年。
lines.en: I have swum this dark channel for millions of years.

lines.zh: 我避开火把的光，往更深处去。
lines.en: I avoid the torchlight and head deeper.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水，我抬头接了一下。
lines.en: Water drips from the roof, and I lift my head to catch it.

lines.zh: 我转身很笨，身体太长了。
lines.en: I turn badly; my body is too long.

lines.zh: 同伴在前，我们从不并排游。
lines.en: A schoolmate leads, and we never swim abreast.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我靠水压认路。
lines.en: In the dark I read the water pressure for direction.

lines.zh: 我游过一块化石，那是我祖先。
lines.en: I pass a fossil in the rock; that is my ancestor.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩底，鳞片刮出白痕。
lines.en: I keep to the floor, scales scraping pale marks.

lines.zh: 雨声从洞口传进来，我才敢出来。
lines.en: Rain reaches me through the cave mouth, and only then do I come out.

lines.zh: 我缓慢地摆尾，像在推一扇重门。
lines.en: I beat my tail slowly, like pushing a heavy door.

lines.zh: 光柱扫过，我缩进石缝。
lines.en: A beam sweeps past and I fold into a crack.

lines.zh: 我游到洞口就停，外面太亮了。
lines.en: I stop at the cave mouth; outside is too bright.

lines.zh: 我用胸鳍撑着石头挪动。
lines.en: I push off the stone with my pectoral fins.

lines.zh: 洞里的水太冷，我游得慢。
lines.en: The cave water is cold. I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根钟乳石柱子。
lines.en: I round a column of stalactite.

lines.zh: 外面下雨了，水声在动。
lines.en: It is raining outside. The water is moving.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块长了鳍的石头。
lines.en: I do not move, a stone that grew fins.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里等雨，雨来了才动。
lines.en: I wait in the dark for rain, and move when it comes.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，让水慢慢从鳃里过。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let water crawl through my gills.

lines.zh: 洞里的水很凉，正合我意。
lines.en: The cave water is cold, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我盯着洞顶，那里挂着一只蝙蝠。
lines.en: I stare at the roof, where a bat hangs.

lines.zh: 我的鳍撑着岩壁，省力。
lines.en: I brace my fins against the wall to save strength.

lines.zh: 几百万年都这么过来的，不急。
lines.en: Millions of years have gone this way; no hurry.

lines.zh: 我听见雷声，雷声让我安心。
lines.en: I hear thunder, and thunder comforts me.

lines.zh: 我把自己塞进石缝，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I wedge myself into a crack with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 有光，我闭上眼等它过去。
lines.en: There is light; I shut my eyes until it passes.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻扫着沙。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the sand, back and forth.

lines.zh: 这片水域我闭着眼也能游。
lines.en: I know these waters well enough to swim blind.

lines.zh: 我吐了口气，泡贴在洞顶不散。
lines.en: I breathe out, and the bubble clings to the roof.

lines.zh: 我还活着，这事我自己也惊讶。
lines.en: I am still alive, which surprises even me.

lines.zh: 你的火把太亮了，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Your torch is too bright, so I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 你举着钓竿，我知道那是什么。
lines.en: You hold a fishing rod, and I know what that is.

lines.zh: 我在暗处看你，你看不见我。
lines.en: I watch you from the dark where you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 你数我的鳍，我数你的手指。
lines.en: You count my fins, and I count your fingers.

lines.zh: 你停下呼吸，我也跟着停。
lines.en: You stop breathing, and I stop as well.

lines.zh: 你把手伸进水里，我退了一尺。
lines.en: You reach into the water and I back off a foot.

lines.zh: 你的灯照到我，我立刻转身。
lines.en: Your lamp finds me and I turn away at once.

lines.zh: 你想必以为我早就灭绝了。
lines.en: You must have thought my kind extinct.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你的脸，很模糊。
lines.en: I see your face through the water, blurred.

lines.zh: 你笑了一下，我不明白意思。
lines.en: You smile, and I cannot tell why.

lines.zh: 我被砍中，血在暗水里散开。
lines.en: The blade lands and blood clouds the dark water.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在旧鳞上，很疼。
lines.en: The cut lands on old scales and hurts.

lines.zh: 我笨重地躲，只躲开一半。
lines.en: I dodge heavily and only half dodge.

lines.zh: 我甩尾撞到岩壁，伤口更开了。
lines.en: My tail hits the wall and the wound opens more.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音闷在水里。
lines.en: I make a sound, muffled by the water.

lines.zh: 伤口翻出白色的肉。
lines.en: The wound shows white flesh.

lines.zh: 我往洞深处退，比平时快。
lines.en: I retreat deeper, faster than usual.

lines.zh: 我活了几百万年，不该这样死。
lines.en: I have lived ages; this is no way to die.

lines.zh: 我咬住岩壁，稳住身体。
lines.en: I bite the rock to steady myself.

lines.zh: 再一下，我的鳍就撑不住了。
lines.en: One more hit and my fins give out.

lines.zh: 那团饵在水里晃，我认得这手法。
lines.en: That bait sways in the water, and I know the trick.

lines.zh: 我先绕饵转一圈，看看有线没线。
lines.en: I circle the bait first to look for the line.

lines.zh: 我从下方贴近，饵的味道很重。
lines.en: I rise from below; the bait smells strong.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了一下，又退开。
lines.en: I test it with my mouth and pull back.

lines.zh: 你换了个饵，这个更腥。
lines.en: You change the bait, and this one is ranker.

lines.zh: 我几百万年没吃过这么香的东西。
lines.en: I have not tasted anything this rich in ages.

lines.zh: 我盯着钩，钩上有一点光。
lines.en: I stare at the hook, which carries a little light.

lines.zh: 我咬了半口，另一半还在钩上。
lines.en: I take half a bite; the rest stays on the hook.

lines.zh: 你收线，我的身体跟着往前。
lines.en: You reel in, and my body follows forward.

lines.zh: 我知道是陷阱，我还是来了。
lines.en: I know it is a trap, and I come anyway.

lines.zh: 你踢到岩壁，碎石砸在我背上。
lines.en: Your boot kicks the wall and rubble hits my back.

lines.zh: 我撞上洞壁，身体太长转不过来。
lines.en: I hit the cave wall; I am too long to turn.

lines.zh: 你游过来，把我挤进石缝。
lines.en: You swim in and squeeze me into a crack.

lines.zh: 同伴的鳍刮过我的侧腹。
lines.en: A schoolmate's fin scrapes across my flank.

lines.zh: 我被水流推着，撞在洞顶。
lines.en: The current shoves me into the roof.

lines.zh: 你的网碰到我，我猛地一挣。
lines.en: Your net touches me and I wrench away hard.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从藏身处撞了出来。
lines.en: That knock drives me out of my hiding place.

lines.zh: 我笨重地侧过身，让路给你。
lines.en: I shift my bulk sideways to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍打到你，抱歉。
lines.en: My tail fin strikes you; I am sorry.

lines.zh: 石缝太窄，我卡了一下。
lines.en: The crack is too narrow and I lodge there.

lines.zh: 我循着极淡的气味找它。
lines.en: I follow a scent so faint it is barely there.

lines.zh: 我们在黑暗里并排悬着。
lines.en: We hang side by side in the dark.

lines.zh: 它的鳍比我的还旧，我喜欢。
lines.en: Its fins are older than mine, and I like that.

lines.zh: 我绕它游了半圈，它没走。
lines.en: I swim half a circle around it and it stays.

lines.zh: 洞深处只有我们两条。
lines.en: Only the two of us are this deep.

lines.zh: 我碰它的侧腹，它回应了。
lines.en: I brush its flank lightly and it answers.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在洞壁上合成一个。
lines.en: Our shadows merge into one on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我等了几百万年才等到它。
lines.en: I waited millions of years for this one.

lines.zh: 它游开一点，我跟上去。
lines.en: It drifts away a little and I follow.

lines.zh: 这片暗水够我们活很久。
lines.en: This dark water will hold us a long while.

lines.zh: 沉到洞底的饵，我捡了。
lines.en: Bait that sank to the cave floor, I take it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴翻动那块东西，确认能吃。
lines.en: I mouth the thing and turn it over to check.

lines.zh: 有东西掉进水里，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: Something falls into the water and I approach slowly.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，试了试。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and taste it.

lines.zh: 这块比石头软，我留下了。
lines.en: This is softer than stone, so I keep it.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西沉到底，归我。
lines.en: What you drop sinks to the bottom, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，又吐出来看了看。
lines.en: I pick it up, spit it out, and look again.

lines.zh: 洞底的碎屑我都会嗅一遍。
lines.en: I sniff every scrap on the cave floor.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，游回石缝里吃。
lines.en: I carry it back into my crack to eat.

lines.zh: 这一块够我撑几天。
lines.en: This piece will last me several days.

lines.zh: 水里有东西在挣扎，我转过去。
lines.en: Something is struggling in the water, and I turn.

lines.zh: 那条鱼比我小太多，我锁住它。
lines.en: That fish is far smaller than me, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，慢慢抬起头。
lines.en: I smell blood and raise my head slowly.

lines.zh: 有东西落水，我盯着那圈波纹。
lines.en: Something falls in, and I watch the ring spread.

lines.zh: 我在暗处看准了它，不动。
lines.en: I pick it out from the dark without moving.

lines.zh: 它游过我洞口，机会来了。
lines.en: It swims past my cave mouth, and here is my chance.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，但我的身体太沉。
lines.en: I have my target, but my body is heavy.

lines.zh: 目标在光里，我不太想过去。
lines.en: The prey is in the light, and I would rather not.

lines.zh: 我认出了那种挣扎的节奏。
lines.en: I know that rhythm of struggling.

lines.zh: 我决定动一次，很难得。
lines.en: I decide to move once, which is rare.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把嘴对准它。
lines.en: I turn slowly and line my mouth up with it.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩底过去，一声不响。
lines.en: I skim the rock floor without a sound.

lines.zh: 它还没察觉我，这样最好。
lines.en: It has not spotted me, which is ideal.

lines.zh: 我离它还有一尺，再等等。
lines.en: One foot to go, so I wait.

lines.zh: 我的鳍压住水流，尽量不惊动。
lines.en: My fins press the current down to stay quiet.

lines.zh: 它往光里游，我停在暗处。
lines.en: It swims toward the light and I stay in the dark.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开，随即又闭上。
lines.en: I open my mouth and then close it.

lines.zh: 这一口要等它靠近洞口。
lines.en: This bite must wait until it nears the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，不急着咬。
lines.en: I follow it without rushing.

lines.zh: 我算好距离，然后停住。
lines.en: I measure the distance and stop.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，牙齿向内倒。
lines.en: I bite down, and my teeth curve inward.

lines.zh: 这一口很重，我的头都甩了。
lines.en: The bite is heavy enough to shake my head.

lines.zh: 我把它拖向洞底。
lines.en: I drag it toward the cave floor.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，我嘴里留着鳞。
lines.en: It tears free and leaves scales in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，用整个身体压它。
lines.en: I ram it and press with my whole body.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到水变红。
lines.en: I hold on until the water turns red.

lines.zh: 我的牙不快，但咬得死。
lines.en: My teeth are slow but they do not let go.

lines.zh: 它踢到我鳃上，我松了口。
lines.en: It kicks my gills and I release.

lines.zh: 我又咬了一口，这次更准。
lines.en: I bite again, better aimed this time.

lines.zh: 猎物沉下去，我慢慢跟。
lines.en: The prey sinks and I follow it down.

lines.zh: 我被线拉出黑暗，第一次见到光。
lines.en: The line pulls me out of the dark into light.

lines.zh: 我从深处被拽上来，鳞上挂着泥。
lines.en: I am hauled up from below with mud on my scales.

lines.zh: 我咬钩的时候，以为是块石头。
lines.en: When I took the hook I thought it was a stone.

lines.zh: 我在桶里，水晃得厉害。
lines.en: I am in a bucket, and the water sloshes hard.

lines.zh: 这条河不该有我，可我在。
lines.en: This river should not hold me, yet here I am.

lines.zh: 我从传说里出来，落到你脚边。
lines.en: I come out of legend and land at your feet.

lines.zh: 我出现在夜里，雨正好在下。
lines.en: I appear at night while the rain is falling.

lines.zh: 你把我拉上岸，我还在摆尾。
lines.en: You pull me onto the bank and I am still thrashing.

lines.zh: 我这张脸几百万年没变过。
lines.en: This face of mine has not changed in ages.

lines.zh: 黑暗没了，我不太习惯。
lines.en: The dark is gone, and I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的鳞，我闻到熟肉味。
lines.en: Fire reaches my scales and I smell cooked meat.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在湿石头上。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water onto wet stone.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃只能空张。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills only open on nothing.

lines.zh: 震动震塌了洞口，我被埋了半截。
lines.en: The blast caves in the mouth and half buries me.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的侧腹，我拽不动。
lines.en: An arrow pins my flank and I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 光一亮，我全身僵住。
lines.en: A flash of light and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 洞里没有吃的，我瘦得只剩骨。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the cave, and I am down to bone.

lines.zh: 雷声穿进水里，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Thunder reaches through the water and I curl tight.

lines.zh: 虚空之下没有水，我在坠落。
lines.en: There is no water below the void, only falling.
